summary: All 5 plan phases complete. Built a seeded measurement harness and baseline (Phase 1), then implemented, rigorously measured, and honestly rejected three encoding-level candidates: E-matching trigger patterns (Phase 2, neutral/regressive outside the 3-formula benchmark), shift-dimension grounding (Phase 3, regressive), and a ForAllTime body-derived trigger (Phase 4, illegal Z3 pattern). Encoding is byte-identical to the Phase 1 baseline throughout (verified by exact rlimit reproduction). Phase 5 ran the Step 6 gate twice: standalone run green (low load), full verify-refactor.sh run red at Step 6 (higher load) -- disagreements=0 both times, confirming the research report's diagnosis that and_box_next and the ternary test's next_A leg sit at ~1.0x headroom, so gate outcome is contention-sensitive. No budget widened, no floor lowered, no test disabled. Outcome is the plan's own anticipated 'measured, no lever found' terminus.

artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan, all phases marked [COMPLETED] with measured outcomes recorded
Full write-up: what was tried/rejected, headroom table, 5 new dead ends (7-11), gate transcripts, recommendation for future smt.qi.profile follow-up

decisions_made: rlimit count is the primary cost metric; wall-clock is secondary and must agree in direction (per plan's binding methodology)
Neutral candidates (|median rlimit delta| < 10%) are reverted, not kept -- applied to the NecessityOperator pattern
Regressive candidates (median cost up, or max(rlimit) up) are reverted immediately -- applied to shift-dimension grounding
A candidate that Z3 rejects outright (invalid pattern) is a stronger negative than a legal-but-harmful one and is recorded as such -- applied to the ForAllTime body-derived trigger
Gate flakiness under contention is the honest, data-backed conclusion, not something to paper over by re-running until green or touching a budget/floor

depth_bounded_skolem_abundance_constraint's return type was left as a single-element list (harmless, verified-equivalent) even after Phase 3's revert, since build_frame_constraints' caller already tolerated a list

Dead end 9: patterns=[is_world(other_world)] on NecessityOperator.true_at -- measured neutral (~0.00% median rlimit delta)
Dead end 10: unrolling depth_bounded_skolem_abundance_constraint's shift_amount dimension into 2*max_shift ForAlls -- measured regressive on 2/3 targets, rule-B-violating on the third
